units.source_text: 黑99刺白中央的虎，白100粘是住院前的一着棋。

en.t: Black 99 pecked at White's tiger's mouth in the center, and White 100 connecting was a move played before the hospitalization.

units.source_text: 名人在其后的讲评中也说：倘使白100不是粘，

en.t: In his later commentary, the Meijin also said that if White 100 had not connected,

units.source_text: 而是限制右边的黑子，防止侵入白模样，

en.t: but had instead restricted the black stones on the right and prevented an invasion into White's framework,

units.source_text: “恐怕黑子面临的局面也不容乐观吧”。

en.t: the position facing Black would probably not have been very optimistic either.

units.source_text: 又，白48可以下在下边的星位，作为布局，“占要地，不能不说也是白子得意的着法”。

en.t: Also, White 48 could have been played on the star point on the lower side as an opening move; occupying that key point must be called a satisfying play for White.

units.source_text: 名人早就在这里看到了“相当有希望”，可以认为，

en.t: It can be thought that the Meijin had already seen here that there was quite a good prospect,

units.source_text: “黑子下47让白子占实地，是过于稳健。

en.t: and that Black 47, by letting White take solid territory, was too cautious.
It should be called a slack move.
